findings.hint: the myapi API is not a published Thunderbird API draft
findings.message:
We are currently not accepting new submissions using Experiment APIs, except unmodified copies of the latest published API drafts (https://github.com/thunderbird/webext-experiments). This ends the review, so no other check ran and this report says nothing about the rest of the add-on. A resubmission without them is reviewed in full. The following cannot be accepted:
Read more: https://thunderbird.topicbox.com/groups/addons/T6ff545fb6d479da5/temporary-pause-on-new-experiment-api-add-on-reviews
